description: This file defines the UsersController class for a REST API, handling user management operations such as creation, retrieval, updating preferences, and deletion within an ASP.NET Core application. It includes interactions with a Keycloak identity provider and Entity Framework Core for database access.

classes.name: UsersController
classes.description: Controller class managing user-related API endpoints, including creating, retrieving, updating preferences, and deleting users, integrating with Keycloak and Entity Framework.

methods.name: CreatOne
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST to create a new user, interacts with Keycloak API to register the user, updates local database, and logs audit action.

methods.name: GetMany
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET to retrieve all users from the database.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET to retrieve a specific user by ID.

methods.name: GetActivity
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET to retrieve audit entries (activity logs) for a specific user, with optional limit.

methods.name: DeleteOne
methods.description: Handles HTTP DELETE to remove a user by ID, with audit logging.

methods.name: PatchOne
methods.description: Handles HTTP PATCH to update user preferences JSON data.
